## FakeBindGroup
interface FakeBindGroup {
    label?: string;
    layout: {
        label?: string;
        entries: GPUBindGroupLayoutEntry[];
    };
    entries: GPUBindGroupEntry[];
}

## FakeBuffer
interface FakeBuffer {
    label?: string;
    size: number;
    usage: number;
    destroyed: boolean;
    readonly mapState: GPUBufferMapState;
    readonly data: Uint8Array;
    mapAsync(mode: number, offset?: number, size?: number): Promise<void>;
    getMappedRange(offset?: number, size?: number): ArrayBuffer;
    unmap(): void;
    destroy(): void;
}

## FakeBufferCopy
interface FakeBufferCopy {
    src: FakeBuffer;
    srcOffset: number;
    dst: FakeBuffer;
    dstOffset: number;
    size: number;
}

## FakeDevice
interface FakeDevice {
    readonly device: GPUDevice;
    readonly buffers: FakeBuffer[];
    readonly textures: FakeTexture[];
    readonly bindGroups: FakeBindGroup[];
    readonly writes: {
        buffer: FakeBuffer;
        offset: number;
        bytes: number;
    }[];
    readonly writeData: {
        data: ArrayBuffer | ArrayBufferView;
        dataOffset: number;
    }[];
    readonly textureWrites: {
        texture: FakeTexture;
        bytesPerRow: number;
        rowsPerImage: number;
        mipLevel: number;
        size: number[];
        data: ArrayBufferView | ArrayBuffer;
    }[];
    readonly passes: FakePass[];
    readonly textureCopies: {
        src: FakeTexture;
        dst: FakeTexture;
        afterPasses: number;
    }[];
    readonly bufferCopies: FakeBufferCopy[];
    readonly querySets: FakeQuerySet[];
    readonly submits: number;
    runPass: ((pass: FakePass) => void) | null;
    readonly errors: string[];
}

## FakeGpuValidationError
class FakeGpuValidationError extends Error {
    readonly name = "GPUValidationError";
}

## FakePass
interface FakePass {
    kind: 'render' | 'compute';
    label?: string;
    desc: unknown;
    commands: PassCommand[];
}

## FakeQuerySet
interface FakeQuerySet {
    label?: string;
    type: GPUQueryType;
    count: number;
    readonly values: BigUint64Array;
    destroyed: boolean;
    destroy(): void;
}

## FakeTexture
interface FakeTexture {
    label?: string;
    width: number;
    height: number;
    format: GPUTextureFormat;
    mipLevelCount: number;
    usage: number;
    destroyed: boolean;
    createView(desc?: {
        label?: string;
    }): FakeView;
    destroy(): void;
}

## FakeView
interface FakeView {
    texture: FakeTexture;
    label?: string;
}

## PassCommand
type PassCommand = {
    op: 'setPipeline';
    pipeline: unknown;
} | {
    op: 'setBindGroup';
    index: number;
    group: unknown;
    offsets: number[];
} | {
    op: 'draw';
    vertices: number;
    instances: number;
    firstInstance: number;
} | {
    op: 'drawIndexed';
    indices: number;
    instances: number;
    firstInstance: number;
    firstIndex?: number;
} | {
    op: 'dispatch';
    x: number;
    y: number;
} | {
    op: 'other';
    name: string;
    args?: number[];
    slot?: number;
    buffer?: unknown;
    offset?: number;
};

## createFakeDevice
function createFakeDevice(limits?: Partial<Record<string, number>>, features?: Iterable<string>): FakeDevice;

## fakeCanvasContext
function fakeCanvasContext(fake: FakeDevice): GPUCanvasContext;

## fakeRendererGpu
function fakeRendererGpu(fake: FakeDevice): {
    device: GPUDevice;
    context: GPUCanvasContext;
    format: GPUTextureFormat;
};

function installGpuGlobals(): void;
